act: Clean Note Policy Version 0.1
title: Deposit of Banknotes by DMBs and CPCs at CBN
responsibility: - Head of Cash Operations - Branch Managers - Vault Supervisors - Head of Compliance - Designated officers interfacing with CPCs
control:
- Implement internal cash sorting and fitness checking procedures
- Use CBN-approved note processing equipment
- Train staff on the visual indicators of unfit/mutilated notes
- Package and label boxes strictly as per CBN requirements
additionalControl:
- Periodic quality audits of sorted notes
- CCTV review of cash handling process
- Escalation process for rejected deposits
- Quarterly refresher training on banknote classification
additionalResponsibility: - Operations Control Unit - Head of Cash Management - Compliance Department - Internal Audit (for spot checks)

title: Re-Circulation of Banknotes by DMBs and CPCs
responsibility: - Cash Operations Team - Vault Custodians - ATM Maintenance Teams - Compliance & Risk Units - Branch Operations Managers
control:
- Deploy only approved and calibrated sorting machines.
- Enforce mandatory processing and classification of all notes.
- Implement dual verification of cash sorting results.
- Regularly train staff on CBN fitness parameters and update them on test pack changes.
- Random audit checks on ATM and OTC notes.
additionalControl:
- Integrate automated monitoring and audit logs for cash sorting machines.
- Conduct monthly internal reviews of notes dispensed through ATMs and counters.
- Establish a penalty recovery process for branches that breach note standards.
additionalResponsibility: - Head of Cash Operations - Chief Compliance Officer - Internal Audit Unit - IT Support (for machine configuration logs)

title: Machines Eligible for Currency Processing in the Industry
responsibility: - Head of Operations - Cash Management Team - IT & Equipment Procurement Unit - Compliance and Internal Control Unit
control:
- Maintain an inventory of all currency processing machines.
- Ensure machines are certified and verified by the CBN.
- Conduct regular calibration and testing based on CBN’s test pack standards.
- Maintain a record of CBN approvals and machine adaptation history.
additionalControl:
- Establish a CBN liaison officer to track machine compliance updates.
- Vendor agreements must include obligation for periodic upgrades to align with CBN standards.
- Include machine conformity checks as part of internal and external audits.
additionalResponsibility: - Head of Procurement & Equipment - Head of Operations - Chief Compliance Officer - CBN Monitoring Desk Liaison

title: Automated Teller Machines (ATMs)
responsibility: - Head of ATM Operations - Cash Management/Branch Operations Team - IT Infrastructure Unit - Compliance Unit
control:
- Ensure ATMs are loaded only with authenticated and fitness-checked notes.
- Conduct routine testing and servicing of ATM sensors for counterfeit detection.
- Use certified sorting machines before ATM loading.
- Maintain an audit trail of cash loading and source of notes.
additionalControl:
- Integrate real-time ATM monitoring for note rejection or customer complaints.
- Periodically retrain ATM custodians and cash handlers.
- Introduce mystery shopping exercises to detect breaches.
- Include ATM note quality check in internal audit scope.
additionalResponsibility: - ATM Service Manager - Operations Risk Officer - Internal Audit Team - Compliance/CBN Liaison Desk

title: Counterfeit Notes Discovered
responsibility: - Branch Operations Manager - Cash & Treasury Management Team - Internal Control Officer - Compliance Department
control:
- Train staff on currency authentication techniques.
- Use CBN-approved currency processing machines with counterfeit detection features.
- Establish a standard operating procedure (SOP) for handling and forwarding counterfeit notes.
- Log and maintain records of all counterfeit incidents.
additionalControl:
- Conduct random reviews of branch-level currency transactions.
- Establish a central counterfeit reporting log across branches.
- Ensure counterfeit notes are tagged with relevant incident reports and forwarded to CBN within stipulated time.
- Include counterfeit incident reporting in audit reviews.
additionalResponsibility: - Cash Officers - Operations Risk Manager - Internal Audit Team - CBN Compliance Liaison

title: Mutilated Banknotes Management
responsibility: - Branch Operations Manager - Cash Officers / Tellers - Treasury Department - Compliance Unit
control:
- Train branch staff on CBN-approved mutilated note handling procedures.
- Maintain a copy of the CBN Operational Manual at all cash-handling branches.
- Use special handling forms and reporting templates for all such transactions.
- Keep proper documentation and audit trail for every mutilated note received or replaced.
additionalControl:
- Schedule periodic refresher training on handling of mutilated notes.
- Perform surprise audits on branches' mutilated notes management processes.
- Integrate mutilated note processing into internal audit scope.
additionalResponsibility: - Head of Operations - Cash Management Unit - Audit & Internal Control

title: Publicity Campaign
responsibility: - Corporate Communications Unit - Operations Department - Branch Operations Managers - Compliance Department
control:
- Integrate CBN sensitization themes in internal campaigns and customer touchpoints.
- Train frontline staff on clean note policy and security features of genuine notes.
- Monitor and prevent issuance of unfit or dirty notes from ATMs and counters.
- Display anti-naira abuse messages in banking halls and on digital platforms.
additionalControl:
- Partner with CBN in joint customer engagement activities.
- Publish quarterly updates on clean note initiatives and performance.
- Use educational infographics in branches and ATMs.
additionalResponsibility: - Head of Corporate Affairs/Communication - Customer Service Management Team - Cash Management Unit

act: Penalty for Payment of Counterfeit Banknotes from ATMs/Teller Points
title: COD/DIR/GEN/CMF/18/095
responsibility: - Cash Management Department - ATM Custodians/Operations Teams - Branch Managers - Internal Audit & Compliance Departments
control:
- Use CBN-approved cash processing machines that verify authenticity.
- Implement regular fitness sorting and counterfeit detection protocols.
- Conduct routine spot testing of ATM dispensed notes.
- Train staff and custodians on CBN's Clean Note Policy.
additionalControl:
- Conduct internal ATM inspections weekly.
- Introduce mystery shopper checks for teller cash quality.
- Keep a log of ATM/teller cash sorting dates and quality certifications.
additionalResponsibility: - Head of Operations & Technology - Head of Cash & Treasury - Compliance & Risk Units

act: Updated Penalty on Inappropriate Cash Disbursement Practices by Deposit Money Banks (DMBs)
title: COD/DIR/INT/CIR/001/025
responsibility: - Head of Cash Management - Branch Managers - Teller Supervisors - Internal Control & Audit Units
control:
- Implement dual authorization for all disbursements of mint notes.
- Maintain detailed logs of mint note inflows and disbursement.
- Conduct internal surveillance of teller and vault operations.
- Limit mint notes to customer-requested withdrawals only.
additionalControl:
- Deploy CCTV and biometric access controls at cash centres.
- Carry out mystery shopper testing internally to assess adherence.
- Train staff on legal implications and ethics around mint note handling.
additionalResponsibility: - COO/Head of Operations - Cash Management Department - Internal Audit/Compliance Units

act: Treatment of Composed Banknotes
title: COD/DIR/INT/CIR/001/006
responsibility: - Head of Cash Operations - Vault/Treasury Officers - Cash Sorting Units - Branch Managers
control:
- Use CBN-approved cash sorting machines with image sensors to detect composed notes.
- Ensure manual verification by trained staff for doubtful notes.
- Maintain segregated logs for suspected mutilated or composed notes.
additionalControl:
- Conduct training for cash handlers on identifying composed notes.
- Sample-check deposits before dispatch to CBN.
- Implement pre-deposit audit checks for all boxes of notes.
additionalResponsibility: - Cash Processing Officers - Head of Operations - Compliance & Internal Control Unit
